name: Route 4 & Cerulean City
summary: Exiting Mt. Moon onto the terraced cliffs of Route 4 downhill toward Cerulean City. Catch wild Ekans and Spearow along the ledges, then stock supplies and Super Splicers in Cerulean City.

items.name: Great Ball
items.method: On the downhill ledge path approaching Cerulean City

navigation_notes: Hop down the one-way ledges on Route 4 into Cerulean City. Be sure to catch an Ekans here if planning early Poison fusions like Gyarados/Arbok before heading to Nugget Bridge.
